Phase-7.NAME: SnarcContextIsolation
Phase-7.purpose: Ensure SNARC memory context is transient model-only context and never persisted as user-authored transcript text.

steps.step-1: Trace the current prompt assembly path from user input to model messages and transcript persistence.
steps.step-2: Define a transient model context envelope for SNARC injected context.
steps.step-3: Update loop behavior so only raw user text is persisted as role=user.
steps.step-4: Add tests proving SNARC context is absent from transcript, export, compaction capture, and user cards.
steps.step-5: Run targeted loop/SNARC tests, typecheck, lint, and MyGRACE lint.
